ledger.title: Phase 6 Coverage Ledger
notes: Sprint 0 activates the Phase 6 ownership map before feature work. Initial later-sprint rows are selectable placeholders until their owning behavior is implemented.

Phase 3 remains owner for server-side field-level patch rebase, same-field conflict transport, and collection conflict values. Phase 6 owns resolver, concurrent-client, and local pending-queue behavior.
authoritative_execution: `backend-unit` selects pure Phase 6 conflict, resolver-contract, and transport-domain rows through the Phase 6 manifest and `backend_unit` execution dependency.
`backend-store` selects service-backed Phase 6 workbook mutation and focused socket route-contract rows through manifest-owned service-backed selection.
`frontend-unit` selects Phase 6 workbook resolver, save-state, and pending-queue component rows through the Phase 6 manifest for `frontend_unit`.
`backend-integration` selects Phase 6 real-runtime WebSocket and concurrent-edit rows through the Phase 6 manifest and `backend_integration` execution dependency.

`browser-e2e-webserver-backed` carries authoritative functional `E-6-*` rows through duration-balanced Playwright manifest-entry shards under `browser_functional`; `browser-e2e-stateful` carries shared-clock session-expiry `E-6-*` rows under `browser_stateful`.
support_execution_extras: Existing Phase 1 and Phase 3 socket, revocation, autosave, and same-field conflict tests remain carryover support evidence and must not claim Phase 6 IDs.

`internal/modules/workbook/phase6_conflict_support_test.go` keeps helper-level workbook conflict regression coverage under `TestSupportPhase6Unit_ConflictHelper*`; the authoritative Phase 6 conflict claims remain the route-owned rows in `phase6_conflict_route_test.go`.

`internal/modules/workbook/phase6_shared_harness_test.go`, `internal/modules/collaboration/phase6_shared_harness_test.go`, and `internal/platform/ws/phase6_ws_test.go` are selected as Phase 6 support evidence for the shared §14 harness layer.
shared_harness: | Machine-readable ownership | `shared_harnesses[]` records support-owned §14 harness coverage separately from authoritative Phase 6 row completion. |

| Workbook route conformance | `internal/testutil/phase6test.Phase6WorkbookRouteInventory()` enumerates Phase 6 workbook create, patch, and conflict-resolve route requirements; `internal/modules/workbook/phase6_shared_harness_test.go` probes envelope, authorization re-derivation, replay/divergent replay, closed vocabulary, writable-string normalization, field-key conformance, attribution, and replay-stability behavior through the real HTTP surface. |

| Incident WebSocket lifecycle | `internal/testutil/phase6test.Phase6SocketEventInventory()`, `internal/modules/collaboration/phase6_shared_harness_test.go`, `internal/platform/ws/phase6_ws_test.go`, and `internal/testutil/incidentwstest` cover Phase 6 socket event ownership, replay filtering, presence scoping, reset behavior, canonical handshakes, and revocation assertions. |

| Grid and browser-command anchors | `packages/grid-adapter/src/index.test.tsx`, `packages/ui-contracts/src/index.test.ts`, `apps/web/e2e/phase6.collaboration.spec.ts`, and `apps/web/e2e/workbook.visual.spec.ts` support §14.7, §14.8, §14.9A, and visual anchor coverage for record and field identity. |
| Workbook resolver helpers | `apps/web/src/WorkbookShell.phase6.test.tsx` holds Phase 6 resolver, save-state, and pending-queue component rows until the UI is split into smaller owner components. |
support_only: `internal/modules/auth/phase1_integration_test.go` keeps Phase 1 session revocation socket coverage as carryover support for Phase 6 implementation, but authoritative Phase 6 completion claims must live in `phase6_*` rows.

`internal/modules/timeline/phase3_integration_test.go` keeps Phase 3 canonical socket and same-field conflict transport coverage as carryover support for Phase 6 implementation, but authoritative Phase 6 completion claims must live in `phase6_*` rows.

`internal/modules/workbook/phase6_conflict_support_test.go` keeps helper-level regression coverage for field-overlap detection, opaque conflict token payloads, clean text merge suggestions, and collection conflict value shaping. These tests run under `TestSupportPhase6Unit_ConflictHelper*` and do not replace `U-6-01` through `U-6-04`.

`internal/modules/workbook/phase6_shared_harness_test.go`, `internal/modules/collaboration/phase6_shared_harness_test.go`, and `internal/platform/ws/phase6_ws_test.go` are Phase 6 support evidence for shared harness conformance and must not claim `U-6-*` or `I-6-*` identifiers.

`internal/modules/workbook/workbook_mutation_integration_test.go` keeps existing workbook mutation conflict coverage as carryover support for Phase 6 implementation, but authoritative Phase 6 completion claims must live in `phase6_*` rows.

`apps/web/src/WorkbookShell.phase3.autosave.test.tsx` keeps Phase 3 autosave and conflict UI coverage as carryover support for Phase 6 implementation, but authoritative Phase 6 completion claims must live in `phase6_*` rows.

notes: Route inventory entries must declare every Phase 6 shared harness as required or n/a.
Socket event inventory covers upgrade, hello/resume, presence, record_changed, job_progress, and session_revoked event families.
Package-level selector and adapter tests are accounting support evidence, not authoritative Phase 6 row IDs.

titles: Phase 6 U-6-09 keeps save-state labels and pending queue replay bounded and explicit
Phase 6 U-6-09 does not coalesce non-contiguous same-record pending patches
Phase 6 U-6-09 fixes the browser-runtime pending queue capacity at exactly 64 replay units
Phase 6 U-6-09 preserves queued work through session revocation and resumes after re-authentication
Phase 6 U-6-09 moves the blocking same-field conflict out of the pending queue and keeps later writes queued
unit.claim: Save-state labels use only `Syncing`, `Saved`, and `Conflict`; the local pending queue is FIFO, bounded, coalesces only contiguous same-record units, and halts on blocking failures without silent eviction or reload restore.

integration.claim: Two real clients connect to the same incident socket, exchange presence snapshots and deltas, and observe deterministic replay ordering within the replay window.
integration.out_of_scope: Browser rendering of presence indicators remains `E-6-01` evidence.

integration.claim: Resume with a valid replay token replays replayable messages only, while presence is rehydrated through the documented presence flow rather than replay.
integration.out_of_scope: Low-level replay filtering helper behavior remains unit evidence.

integration.claim: Concurrent edits to different fields succeed without operator intervention, while concurrent edits to the same field produce the resolver path and preserve both saved and local drafts correctly.
integration.out_of_scope: Full browser resolver interaction remains `E-6-02` evidence.

integration.claim: Cookie-authenticated browser socket upgrades reject untrusted `Origin` values before incident subscription is granted.
integration.out_of_scope: General host and origin policy helpers remain platform support evidence.

e2e.title: E-6-01 shows two analysts each other's workbook presence within the expected interaction window
e2e.claim: Two analysts on the same incident see each other's presence on the workbook surface within the expected interaction window, with the browser row retaining a timing artifact for the 1-second presence validation.
e2e.out_of_scope: Socket-level presence canonicalization remains backend evidence.

e2e.title: E-6-02 auto-merges different-field concurrent edits and requires explicit same-field resolution
e2e.claim: Concurrent edits to different fields on the same row auto-merge, while concurrent edits to the same field open the same-surface resolver and require explicit analyst resolution.
e2e.out_of_scope: Resolver state unit behavior remains frontend-unit evidence.

e2e.title: E-6-03 preserves unsaved local work after socket revocation and re-authentication
e2e.claim: Representative route-owned browser revocation sources, including admin revoke-all, current-session logout, concurrency-limit eviction, and shared-clock idle expiry, emit `session_revoked`, close the socket, and preserve unsaved local work for explicit recovery and FIFO replay after re-authentication.
e2e.out_of_scope: Browser evidence proves UI preservation and replay after representative route-owned revocation sources. Low-level revocation-source correctness remains backend and integration evidence.

e2e.title: E-6-04 keeps live updates conflict markers and presence markers anchored to record_id and field_key
e2e.claim: Live updates never retarget pending local edits from implemented browser command surfaces, same-field conflict markers, row-gutter presence markers, or same-cell presence markers away from the bound `record_id` and `field_key` during sorting, filtering, grouping, virtual scrolling, or live row patch.
e2e.out_of_scope: Current-product Enter, Tab, blur, and single-cell paste completion are covered here. Multi-cell paste-matrix anchoring, fill-down, multi-row tag assignment, and broader future grid-command translation remain Phase 9 grid/paste evidence under `I-9-GRID-01` and shared `I-GRID-03` unless product scope moves earlier.

e2e.title: E-6-05 replays queued unsent writes after re-authentication without silent reload restore
e2e.claim: Within one browser runtime, queued unsent writes survive transient transport loss, real HTTP auth failure, or session revocation; replay in FIFO order after recovery or re-authentication; halt on the first real same-field conflict without applying later queued writes; and are never silently restored after a full reload.
e2e.out_of_scope: Queue size and coalescing unit semantics remain frontend-unit evidence.

visual.title: V-6-GRID-01 regresses Phase 6 row-gutter and same-cell presence markers
visual.claim: The visual harness asserts deterministic Timeline row-gutter and same-cell presence marker presentation keyed by `record_id` and `field_key` from real browser presence state against a stable screenshot baseline.
visual.out_of_scope: Socket payload canonicalization and timing remain backend and functional browser evidence.

visual.title: V-6-GRID-02 regresses Phase 6 same-field conflict marker resolver and Conflict strip
visual.claim: The visual harness asserts same-field conflict marker, same-surface resolver, and `Conflict` save-state strip presentation after a real backend `same_field_conflict` against a stable screenshot baseline.
visual.out_of_scope: Same-field conflict transport and resolver mutation semantics remain owned by `E-6-02`, route/component rows, and frontend-unit evidence.

visual.title: V-6-GRID-03 regresses Phase 6 pending-queue save-state transitions
visual.claim: The visual harness asserts `Syncing`, same-field-conflict `Conflict`, and resolver-recovered `Saved` save-state presentations against stable screenshot baselines.
visual.out_of_scope: Pending-queue FIFO, boundedness, halt/replay behavior, and queue recovery semantics remain owned by `E-6-05`, `U-6-09`, and supporting frontend-unit evidence.
